title: picea excelsa var. obovata
intro: Picea excelsa var. obovata, commonly known as Himalayan spruce, is a variety of spruce tree native to the Himalayan region. The bark of this plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Picea excelsa var. obovata include its use as an anti-diarrheal agent, due to its astringent properties, and as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
